description: This file defines a configuration class for integrating Google GenAI models within the litellm framework. It includes methods for parameter mapping, environment validation, authentication management, request transformation, and response processing, specifically tailored for Google GenAI's API format.

classes.name: GoogleGenAIConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for calling Google models in their native format, extending base classes for content generation configuration and Vertex AI LLM integration.

methods.name: Literal["gemini","vertex_ai"] custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Returns the string 'gemini', indicating the LLM provider type.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the configuration class, calling parent initializers for base content config and VertexLLM.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_generate_content_optional_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported optional parameters for Google GenAI models.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] map_generate_content_optional_params( self, generate_content_config_dict: GenerateContentConfigDict, model: str, )
methods.description: Maps generic parameters to Google-specific format, converting parameter names to camelCase as required by Google GenAI API.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, api_key: Optional[str], headers: Optional[dict], model: str, litellm_params: Optional[Union[GenericLiteLLMParams, dict]], )
methods.description: Constructs and returns appropriate headers, including the API key, for Google GenAI API requests.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_google_ai_studio_api_key(self, litellm_params: dict)
methods.description: Retrieves the API key from parameters or environment.

methods.name: Tuple[Any,Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_common_auth_components( self, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Fetches authentication credentials, project, and location for Vertex AI.

methods.name: Tuple[dict,str] _build_final_headers_and_url( self, model: str, auth_header: Optional[str], vertex_project: Optional[str], vertex_location: Optional[str], vertex_credentials: Any, stream: bool, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Builds the final HTTP headers and API URL based on authentication info.

methods.name: Tuple[dict,str] sync_get_auth_token_and_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], model: str, litellm_params: dict, stream: bool, )
methods.description: Synchronously obtains API headers and URL for requests.

methods.name: Tuple[dict,str] get_auth_token_and_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], model: str, litellm_params: dict, stream: bool, )
methods.description: Asynchronously obtains API headers and URL, handling credential retrieval.

methods.name: dict transform_generate_content_request( self, model: str, contents: GenerateContentContentListUnionDict, tools: Optional[ToolConfigDict], generate_content_config_dict: Dict, system_instruction: Optional[Any] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms high-level generate content parameters into an API request dictionary.

methods.name: GenerateContentResponse transform_generate_content_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Processes raw API responses into structured format, with error handling and citation conversion.

methods.name: Dict convert_citation_sources_to_citations(self, response: Dict)
methods.description: Converts 'citationSources' fields in response to 'citations' to match SDK expectations.
